scope: read-only analysis; deployment and historical evidence unchanged

raw_first_b2.scope: original raw, GT z>=1.5m; original fixed registration; no fitting

findings: No camera dropout or pad leaving view during the examined approach intervals.
ID19 is detected in all 460 recent position-outlier frames; absence from inlier_ids is a post-PnP classification, not absence of detection.
Original raw pair 16.7ms apart shows ID19 quad shrinking 5-8px inward while other marker corners move less than 0.4px.
All 15 raw combined-pose outliers retain exactly one ID19 corner in the second LM fit even though ID19 is absent from the full-marker inlier list.
Removing ID19 from those exact raw frames recovers all 15; removing ID43 does not resolve the issue.
Large GT attitude impulses also exist and must not be attributed to visual PnP.
limitations: Recent four bags intentionally omit image_raw; exact counterfactual replay uses the first B2 raw flight, and recent annotated images corroborate inward ID19 quads.
Per-marker inlier membership uses nearest receipt within 8ms because these messages lack capture stamps; unmatched associations are reported.
Independent single-marker PnP errors use the same frozen registration and configured camera mount. They do not uniquely measure physical attachment error.
The 30-35 flight briefly satisfied the router gate; this does not establish simultaneous trial marker dwell and arrival dwell.

brief_switch_on_twelfth_entry.interpretation: Router stability briefly exceeded one second, but output had not yet switched because marker capture stamps trailed the last OptiTrack output stamp. Pose inconsistency returned before valid descent admission.
